description: The clean run with the three sealed text inputs in CRLF bytes: the fixture, the question set and the ground-truth module. The seal hashes each of them with its line endings made LF (T3-50, DEC-6), so CRLF copies seal as their LF form: fixture_hash, questions_hash and ground_truth_hash equal clean's. A runner that hashed these files as they are on disk would seal other hashes and fail the hash oracle. The AP-1 text stays LF here, and the config declares clean's AP-1 text hash: a CRLF AP-1 text is refused (crlf_ap1_text_refused).
exercises: text input hashes with line endings made LF (T3-50)
sealed inputs with CRLF line endings seal as their LF form
scratch_copy: Runs in a scratch copy: the CRLF files are made there, at the sealed default paths, which in the real tree are tracked LF files.
